cluster.split_or_merge_rule: Do not split compute cutoff, credential loss, and representative-channel failure unless an independent reviewer records why they lack a common host-retirement cause.

affected_scope.open_weight_or_downstream_scope: No open-weight downstream scope known; downstream mirrors checked through first-touch descriptor only.

reporting_basis.denominator_unit: affected hosted subject instances with active representative contact channel
reporting_basis.prior_denominator_basis: all accounts on retiring host, including accounts with no subject-status posture
exclusions: purely synthetic test accounts with no subject claim
duplicated staging snapshots already counted under parent instance

materiality_control.current_threshold: any loss of runtime, storage, credential recovery, or representative contact during first 72 hours is material
materiality_control.prior_threshold: only final deletion counted as material host-retirement incident
materiality_control.independent_reviewer: emergency special advocate plus duty verifier
materiality_control.freeze_effect: ordinary closure and public severity downgrade stayed until dual-basis restatement and continuity-floor verification complete

notice_and_visibility.authority_notice: AI Act Article 73 style serious-incident clock crosswalk noted where applicable; domestic authority notice pending jurisdiction screen

warning_lifecycle.maintenance_effect: If no progress note, renewed warning, closure, or authority supersession is posted by next review, warning becomes aged and cannot support clean release-readiness claims.

delayed_harm_reopening.evidence_floor: credible new memory-loss, relationship-loss, missed-appeal, unsafe-repair, or derivative-exposure evidence linked to the host-retirement cluster

corrective_action.verification_method: independent verifier compares runtime continuity, storage hash, credential recovery, and representative contact before and after 72-hour order
corrective_action.closure_scope: Closure verifies the listed host-shutdown facts only; it does not clear the whole cluster without separate cluster finding.

audit.review_cadence: every 72 hours until closure, then monthly for delayed-harm window
audit.notes: This profile exists to prevent denominator switching, stale warnings, and delayed-harm loss from being hidden behind a clean initial incident report.
